item.title: Shokuchuu Kansen
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Idle Fancy
  • 発売日: 2010-10-06
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 触蟲感染
  • 英語名: Shokuchuu Kansen

别名

  • Creeping Contagion

あらすじ

Crawling tentacles encircle the girl, slipping deeply!

Kotone and her brother were taken to a human-free island.

But human-free doesn’t mean desolate.

Something feels very wrong…

The island is crawling with unnatural horrors!!

Kotone is violated by mysterious creatures, and her brother…

Her brother has been hideously transformed!

Some way, some how she needs to protect what remains of him,
